value.rationale: The product multiples k ab are a canonical arithmetic target family with ordinary nonnegative representations for every k; coprimality imposes a sharp structural obstruction. The complete first universal prefix and minimal failing multiplier 16 give an exact natural cutoff, explained by prime allocation rather than a numerical census. Infinitely many coprime pairs share the first failure. Neither a paper-scale extension nor a general future theorem is assumed.
